text:
anna: T-12m for morning cutover. Quick rollcall: who is pin/unpin, who runs canary verification, who owns rollback? @ryan @leah
ryan: I will handle pin/unpin and roll forward steps. Ready to execute commands.
leah: I9ll run the functional smoke and log checks. Oncall for first 30m.
carlos: I9m watching networking + cache tiers. Will call if p99 spikes.
deploy-bot: Dry-run result for rollout 1722223333: image digest mismatch on svc-embed (expected abc123, found abc124). Can proceed to partial canary in us-west only with override.
anna: typo: should be anna, not anna :)
anna: ack. Thanks deploy-bot. Ryan 5— do you want to abort or restrict to us-west?
ryan: Restrict to us-west. We do not want eu to touch this until digest is resolved. Plan: 1) start canary in us-west-2 at 5% traffic 2) watch 15m 3) expand if clean. Commands I'll run:
```
# start regional canary
deploy-bot rollout --region us-west-2 --percent 5 --image redwood/api:20240518
# pin to dedicated pool after pass
redwoodctl pin set redwood-api@dedicated --version=v3.4.2
```
leah: Smoke checklist I9ll post after canary warms. Main quick checks: health endpoints, sample-gen parity, embeddings sanity.
carlos: Cache warmup note: clear prefix cache only in canary prior to traffic shift: `cachectl purge --prefix=canary-1722223333`
infra-bot: Alert channels active: #pager, #infra, #release-war-room. Thresholds: p99 latency > 400ms OR error-rate > 1.5% triggers page.
anna: If we see token-cost spike but no functional errors -> reduce batch size and enable quantized variant for canary only. Ryan, do you have a quick script?
ryan: Yes: `scripts/toggle_batch_quant.sh canary-1722223333 downsize 0.5 quantize true`
leah: Running warmup now (starting 06:00:00Z). Will paste smoke results here.
06:12:10Z leah: warmup done. health OK, 100 sample requests pass, embeddings diff < 0.5%
06:24:05Z deploy-bot: Canary 5% us-west-2 active. Bake timer 15m started.
06:30:20Z leah: smoke run complete: success=98/100, 2 timeouts (transient). Logging traces to S3: s3://redwood-release/traces/1722223333.log
06:34:00Z carlos: noticing small retransmit bump, p99 still 320ms, below threshold.
06:37:10Z infra-bot: monitoring note: cost/sec trending 1.1x baseline, not yet critical.
ryan: Given small transient timeouts I suggest hold and continue bake. If we hit >1% errors in next 5m we abort.
anna: Agree. Holding expansion. Leah continue smoke cadence every 3m.
06:42:15Z leah: smoke: success=100/100. No new timeouts.
06:45:00Z ryan: OK expanding to 25% in us-west-2. Command:
```
deploy-bot rollout --region us-west-2 --percent 25 --from canary-1722223333
```
06:55:00Z infra-bot: p99 now 350ms, error-rate 0.6%, cost 1.15x. Still stable.
07:02:00Z deploy-bot: Rollout paused for eu region due to digest mismatch. Reminder: resolve image tag before eu.
07:10:00Z ryan: Post-launch TODOs: 1) open PR to fix digest pin 2) coordinate with build for manifest republish 3) unpin legacy svc after 1h if stable.
anna: Support ask: can someone draft a short note for #release-notes explaining regional roll (us-west only) and eu delay? Leah can you draft?
leah: Drafting now, will post in 10m.
anna: Final call: if error-rate crosses 1.5% we rollback immediately. Rollback command if needed:
```
# rollback to previous stable
deploy-bot rollback --service redwood-api --to-revision stable-271
```
leah: Confirming handover: Ryan will continue pins/unpins, Leah continues verification 06:55-07:30UTC, Carlos monitors infra. This thread remains primary comms.
ryan: Confirmed.
carlos: Confirmed.
anna: Thanks team. Locking thread for post-launch notes. :lock:
